frases: That fire pit is way too close to your house!
Hit like and follow. Flo wanted it right by the door!
It's cozy! I can grab snacks without walking!
Sparks float up and drift. Wood siding, a deck, a tree branch, they can all catch.
And under that tree? The heat rises right into the leaves.
So how far is far enough?
Most safety guides say at least ten feet from your house and anything that burns.
Some towns say twenty five. Check your local fire rules.
Keep it out from under branches, and never on a covered porch.
And if it gets out of hand?
Keep a hose or an extinguisher close, and never leave the fire alone.
Fine. Ten steps for snacks. I'll survive.
Cozy by the door, or ten feet away? Team Norm or Team Flo?
Follow for more backyard builds that won't fail!
